title: Analyze Transmittance of a Dilution

nodes.title: Place flask
nodes.description: Place the volumetric flask upright on the bench.

feedback.retry: Review Place flask and try again.

nodes.title: Place cylinder
nodes.description: Place the graduated cylinder beside the flask.

feedback.retry: Review Place cylinder and try again.

nodes.title: Measure stock dye
nodes.description: Use the graduated cylinder to measure 8 mL of stock dye.

feedback.retry: Review Measure stock dye and try again.

nodes.title: Transfer aliquot
nodes.description: Pour the measured stock dye into the volumetric flask.

feedback.retry: Review Transfer aliquot and try again.

nodes.title: Add water below mark
nodes.description: Add water below the calibration mark.

feedback.retry: Review Add water below mark and try again.

nodes.title: Swirl flask
nodes.description: Use a gentle swirl to mix the partially diluted dye.

feedback.retry: Review Swirl flask and try again.

nodes.title: Top up to mark
nodes.description: Add water dropwise until the meniscus rests on the mark.

feedback.retry: Review Top up to mark and try again.

nodes.title: Stopper flask
nodes.description: Seat a stopper in the volumetric flask.

feedback.retry: Review Stopper flask and try again.

nodes.title: Invert to mix
nodes.description: Use repeated inversions to mix the stoppered flask.

feedback.retry: Review Invert to mix and try again.

nodes.title: Place spectrophotometer
nodes.description: Place the spectrophotometer on the workbench.

feedback.retry: Review Place spectrophotometer and try again.

nodes.title: Fill blank cuvette
nodes.description: Add deionized water to the blank cuvette.

feedback.retry: Review Fill blank cuvette and try again.

nodes.title: Wipe blank cuvette
nodes.description: Use a wipe to clean the outside of the blank cuvette.

feedback.retry: Review Wipe blank cuvette and try again.

nodes.title: Zero instrument
nodes.description: Place the blank in the instrument and zero it.

feedback.retry: Review Zero instrument and try again.

nodes.title: Fill sample cuvette
nodes.description: Add diluted dye to the sample cuvette.

feedback.retry: Review Fill sample cuvette and try again.

nodes.title: Wipe sample cuvette
nodes.description: Use a wipe to clean and orient the sample cuvette.

feedback.retry: Review Wipe sample cuvette and try again.

nodes.title: Insert sample
nodes.description: Place the sample cuvette in the spectrophotometer.

feedback.retry: Review Insert sample and try again.

nodes.title: Read %T
nodes.description: Record the percent transmittance reading.

feedback.retry: Review Read %T and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate decimal T
nodes.description: Convert percent transmittance to decimal transmittance.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate decimal T and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate absorbance
nodes.description: Calculate absorbance using A = -log10(T).

feedback.retry: Review Calculate absorbance and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate concentration
nodes.description: Use M1V1 = M2V2 to calculate diluted dye concentration.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate concentration and try again.
